description: This file defines the ServiceStartArguments class, an Android Service implementation that demonstrates background service handling, including message processing with Handler, notification management, and starting/stopping logic. It also contains an inner Controller Activity class with UI elements to initiate and control the service.

classes.name: ServiceStartArguments
classes.description: An Android Service class that handles messages in a background thread, shows notifications, and manages service lifecycle including start, destroy, and binding.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes notification manager, creates handler thread, and sets up the service handler.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Handles incoming start intents, sends messages to the handler, and manages process death simulation.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources, stops handler thread, and cancels notifications.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns null as binding is not supported.

methods.name: showNotification
methods.description: Creates and displays a persistent notification while the service runs.

inner_classes.name: ServiceHandler
inner_classes.description: Handles messages sent to the service, performs simulated work, and manages notifications.

inner_classes.name: Controller
inner_classes.description: An Activity class providing UI buttons to start and control the ServiceStartArguments service, demonstrating different start scenarios like normal start, redelivery, failure simulation, and process kill.

methods.name: showNotification
methods.description: Constructs and posts a notification with specified text.

methods.name: hideNotification
methods.description: Removes the notification from the notification manager.
